trainmeet.station-outside-1.OverviewDraw.description:
The outside's overview (FR31, FR48, TKL88): a simple drawing, in a grid read from left to
right, of the tracks, switches and main signals that are controlled centrally. Every signal
and switch sits on a horizontal line, as in the remote picture. Tracks no catalogue route
reaches are left out, and there are no switch numbers, dwarf signals or addresses. Each
catalogue route names the pieces and links it lays, in order, so that a locked route can be
drawn and the switches' lie seen. Studio makes it from the drawing.

trainmeet.station-model-1.Address.description:
A decoder or detector address on a bus (level 3).

Its own origin says where the address comes from and whether it is confirmed on the layout:
in Koppla in a confirmed address is green, an address that is only given is yellow
(STUDIO-17). The object's origin is about the object itself, as drawn or imported.

trainmeet.station-model-1.BorderSwitch.description:
Gränsväxel (grindväxel): a switch at the border between a part's area and the station's.

Its owner lays it both ways. The other side may always lay it towards the part's area, where
it keeps the two apart, and never out (TKL99, RANG-12); Klart and Grindar lay it back there.
A route out over it is a request that the station's interlocking sets.

trainmeet.station-model-1.Lever.description:
Spak: for + and -, the position each switch gets.

The lever's own switches are in both positions. A switch that only one position names is
dragged along by the lever in that position (drar med, TKL104) and has a lever of its own.
An own switch that gets - in the lever's + lies reversed (omvänd).

trainmeet.station-model-1.StationPart.description:

the station's one interlocking, which locks every route.

Its area is the same kind of area as local release's (TKL103): track circuits or pieces,
the switches the part lays freely and the signals in it. Its border is the border switches,
with their owner, and the signals at the border. The part may be its own driftplats in
Hubben (TKL101). Its switch streets and the routes out it may request belong to it.

Växel, korsningsväxel eller korsning: the node where pieces divide or cross.

An ordinary switch or a Y-switch has a trunk, a straight leg (+) and a diverging leg (-); its
number is the part that a lever lays. A slip has four pieces, its parts and the paths through
it; a crossing without a switch has only the paths.

trainmeet.tkl-1.drawing.description:
Rita: the station as the owner draws it, the station model with its panel plan.

The panel plan is the drawing (STD-25, TKL81): every switch, crossing and track end in a
cell, every track a way over the grid from node to node, horizontally, vertically or at
45°, with the joints between its pieces. The six objects stand on it: the tracks' pieces,
the switches, the signals, the track-circuit boundaries, the buffer stops and the line exits
(STUDIO-02). What is not drawn is computed when the drawing becomes the model: the nodes'
types, the track circuits between the boundaries, the signals that lead out at each exit,
and where the panel shows the signals, the exits and the track names (tkl/studio/rita.py).
The routes are never drawn (STD-07).

A station without a plan of its own opens on the engine's layout, the first proposal
(STD-09). While the owner has only named things on it, the proposal is not kept as a plan,
and the engine lays the panel out again.

trainmeet.tkl-1.rita.TklDrawing.description:
Rita: the station as the owner draws it, the station model with its panel plan.

The panel plan is the drawing (STD-25, TKL81): every switch, crossing and track end in a
cell, every track a way over the grid from node to node, horizontally, vertically or at
45°, with the joints between its pieces. The six objects stand on it: the tracks' pieces,
the switches, the signals, the track-circuit boundaries, the buffer stops and the line exits
(STUDIO-02). What is not drawn is computed when the drawing becomes the model: the nodes'
types, the track circuits between the boundaries, the signals that lead out at each exit,
and where the panel shows the signals, the exits and the track names (tkl/studio/rita.py).
The routes are never drawn (STD-07).

A station without a plan of its own opens on the engine's layout, the first proposal
(STD-09). While the owner has only named things on it, the proposal is not kept as a plan,
and the engine lays the panel out again.

trainmeet.tkl-1.cad-import.TklDrawing.description:
Rita: the station as the owner draws it, the station model with its panel plan.

The panel plan is the drawing (STD-25, TKL81): every switch, crossing and track end in a
cell, every track a way over the grid from node to node, horizontally, vertically or at
45°, with the joints between its pieces. The six objects stand on it: the tracks' pieces,
the switches, the signals, the track-circuit boundaries, the buffer stops and the line exits
(STUDIO-02). What is not drawn is computed when the drawing becomes the model: the nodes'
types, the track circuits between the boundaries, the signals that lead out at each exit,
and where the panel shows the signals, the exits and the track names (tkl/studio/rita.py).
The routes are never drawn (STD-07).

A station without a plan of its own opens on the engine's layout, the first proposal
(STD-09). While the owner has only named things on it, the proposal is not kept as a plan,
and the engine lays the panel out again.

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Part.description:
The rules at the border, set per station in Studio (TKL99). The defaults are those of
the first station divided into parts (TKL99): the station steers the border switches, the
part may lay them towards its area and never out, and an approved request can only be
returned.

lays_towards_part.description: Delen får lägga stationens gränsväxlar mot sitt område, aldrig ut (RANG-12). Annars lägger bara stationen dem.
lays_towards_part.title: Lays Towards Part

one_way.description: Envägsregeln (RANG-09): en godkänd begäran kan delen bara lämna tillbaka, aldrig lägga själv, och stationen tar inte tillbaka den medan den är delens.
one_way.title: One Way

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Part.title: PartRules

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Part.description: Ände: the end of the part a switch street or a route out belongs to (TKL109, TKL122).
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Part.title: PartSide

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Posi.description: A switch's two positions. + is straight (rakt), - is diverging (avvikande).
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Posi.title: Position

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Rout.description: Who laid a route, or switched an automat (FR33, FR37).
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Rout.title: RouteBy

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Swit.description: Who lays the switch. Only TKL's switches have a lever, and no route crosses another.
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.Swit.title: SwitchControl

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklA.description: What a signal shows. A combined signal shows SHUNT with the dwarf part (STV-24).
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklA.title: TklAspect

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklA.description:
A station automat switched on in the station's interlocking (FR24–FR27): who switched it,
and for A1, A2, AN and AU the trains it has taken in and laid out.
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklA.title: TklAutomatOn

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklE.description:
A line exit: the line's pieces outside the entry signal, which belong to the line and
never turn green with a route (STV-54), and what goes up to Hubben as signal.exit.
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklE.title: TklExitShown

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.description:
Ställverket på nivå 3 med LocoNet: what the layout has reported, and what TKL has
ordered. Unknown is None: nothing counts as free or in place until it is reported.

switches.description: Växeldelarnas återrapporterade lägen.
switches.title: Switches

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.title: TklField

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.description:
The station's remote control in its interlocking (#36 del b): who controls it, the
automats that are on and the magazine. Kept with the interlocking.

controller.description: Fjärrstyrs från …: stationens egen panel lägger då inget (FR6, FR17).
controller.title: Controller

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.title: TklFjarrState

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.description: One of a function's positions: a traction current's mode, or a turntable's track.
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.title: TklFunctionMode

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.description:
A panel function from the catalogue (STV-04) with its state of the moment: what the
panel draws and what is saved with the interlocking. The parameters are the model's.

name.description: Funktionens namn, som i stationsmodellen. Unikt i stationen.
name.title: Name

on.description: Inkopplad: signalstopp, lokal frigivning, ur drift eller programmeringsspår.
on.title: On

mode.description: Körströmmens läge, eller spåret vändskivans brygga står mot.
mode.title: Mode

pieces.description: Spårbitarna funktionen gäller: området eller spåret.
pieces.title: Pieces

signals.description: Signalerna i stopp, eller som visar växling.
signals.title: Signals

blocked.description: Infartssignalerna som spärras medan området är lokalt frigivet (FR41).
blocked.title: Blocked

switches.description: De lokala växlarna, som läggs med knappar på modulerna.
switches.title: Switches

locked.description: Skyddsväxlarnas spakar och läget de låses i.
locked.title: Locked

at.description: Noden knappen hör till i spårplanen.
at.title: At

codes.description: Knappens kod per skal, till exempel L01 i 95.
codes.title: Codes

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklF.title: TklFunctionShown

by.description: Vem som gjorde det: delställverkets namn eller Tågklareraren (RANG-05).
by.title: By

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklI.description:
Ställverkets läge i stunden (STV-08): everything the panel draws, kept with the station
so that a restart keeps it. Never the model, the clearance or the timetable (STV-09).

revision.description: Räknar upp vid varje ändring; väntan följer den.
revision.title: Revision

problem.description: Läget gäller inte stationsmodellen: allt utom nollställning nekas.
problem.title: Problem

levers.description: Spakarnas lägen; inget när spakens växlar ligger i kors.
levers.title: Levers

tracks.description: Sektionerna på stationsspåren, med spårets namn: där ett tåg kan sättas ut.
tracks.title: Tracks

sections.description: Sektionerna med sina spårbitar: där 59 har sina lampor, en till fyra per spårledning, och avbrotten mellan spårledningarna.
sections.title: Sections

functions.description: Panelfunktionerna ur katalogen, med sitt läge (STV-04, STV-53).
functions.title: Functions

last_id.description: Det senaste id:t för en väg eller ett tåg.
last_id.title: Last Id

field.description: Nivå 3 med LocoNet ansluten (eller låtsas-LocoNet): spårledningarna styr tågnumren och växlarna återrapporterar (STV-15). Inget: nivå 1–2, med knapparna.

ready.description: Klara att skicka, i stationens ordning: efter avgångstiden i planen, och som stationen har flyttat dem (TKL108).
ready.title: Ready

fjarr.description: Fjärrstyrningen: vem som styr, automaterna och magasinet (#36 del b).

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklI.title: TklInterlocking

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklM.description:
A route in the magazine (magasinering, FR45): it conflicts with a set route, and is laid
by itself once that route is released, after a delay so that the train is wholly in.
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklM.title: TklMagazined

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklN.description:
Var ett tågnummer står (STV-06, STV-21): the section or the exit, its pieces, and the
station track when the section is on one, where the track's name is hidden (STV-57).

track.description: Stationsspåret, med modellens namn.
track.title: Track

estimated.description: Numret följer knapparna, inte detekteringen: en uppskattad position.
estimated.title: Estimated

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklN.title: TklNumber

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.description:
What the part was refused, and why: by the interlocking at once (RANG-10), or by the
station (Neka).
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.title: TklPartRefusal

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.description: Begäran (TKL98, RANG-03): a route out that a part has asked the station for.

route_out.description: Den begärda vägens id i delen.
route_out.title: Route Out

said.description: Som rutan säger den: spåret delen kommer från och spåret ut, till exempel 52 → 3, eller vägens namn.
said.title: Said

route.description: Den lagda vägen, när den är godkänd.
route.title: Route

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.title: TklPartRequest

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.description:
A route out (RANG-03) as the part's screen shows it: whether a request can go now, and
the request when there is one.

reason.description: Varför en begäran inte kan gå nu.
reason.title: Reason

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.title: TklPartRouteOut

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.description:
Ett delställverk (TKL97–TKL103) as both screens show it: the area, the border, the
switch streets and the routes out, with the requests, the ring and Fika.

switches.description: Delens egna växeldelar.
switches.title: Switches

rings.description: Delen ringer: sedan när, tills stationen svarar (TKL98).
rings.title: Rings

fika.description: Delen har fika: skärmen är låst tills den är tillbaka.
fika.title: Fika

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.title: TklPartShown

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.description: A switch street (RANG-02) as the part's screen shows it.

laid.description: Varje växel i gatan ligger i sitt läge.
laid.title: Laid

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklP.title: TklPartStreet

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklR.description:
Klart att skicka (TKL108): a train a part has announced ready to send, in the station's
list.

track.description: Spåret tåget står på.
track.title: Track

departure.description: Avgångstiden i planen. Ett inskrivet nummer har ingen.
departure.title: Departure

moved.description: Stationen har flyttat det i listan.
moved.title: Moved

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklR.title: TklReady

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklR.description: Vad ställverket rapporterar upp till Hubben (STV-10), and how it went.

track.description: Stationsspårets id i utsidan.
track.title: Track

occupied.description: Nivå 3: linjens spårledning vid utfarten är belagd.
occupied.title: Occupied

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklR.title: TklReport

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklS.description:
A section of a set route, in the order the route runs through it: a track circuit, or
where the model has none, the pieces between two switches, signals or ends (spårdel). It
is released behind the train, one at a time (STV-29).

pieces.description: Vägens spårbitar i delen, i färdriktningen.
pieces.title: Pieces

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklS.title: TklSectionPart

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklS.description: Lagd väg: a train route or shunting route the interlocking has set and locked.

chain.description: Den sammansatta vägens första del, när vägen är en del av en (TKL53).
chain.title: Chain

positions.description: Växlarna vägen lägger: sina egna, de kopplade och de som dras med (TKL104).
positions.title: Positions

protection.description: Växlar vägen låser utan att gå över dem: spakens andra halva och sidoskyddet, närmaste växel på varje spår som ansluter, lagd bort från vägen (skyddsväxlar, STV-20).
protection.title: Protection

turntable.description: Vändskivans spår som bryggan står mot, medan vägen håller.
turntable.title: Turntable

train.description: Tåget som tar vägen, när det är känt.
train.title: Train

at.description: Delen där tågets front är: -1 innan tåget har passerat starten.
at.title: At

aspect.description: Vad startsignalen visar för vägen just nu.

held.description: Vägen ligger kvar med sina lås men signalerna visar stopp, med skälet: signalstopp eller ett spår ur drift. Den visar kör igen först när den läggs på nytt.
held.title: Held

passed.description: Signaler i färdriktningen som visar vägens besked tills tåget har passerat dem (STV-19).
passed.title: Passed

leaves.description: Linjeutfarten vägen leder ut till: förbi målet är linjen.
leaves.title: Leaves

waiting.description: Nivå 3: växlarna vägen väntar på återrapport från. Signalen visar stopp tills alla ligger rätt.
waiting.title: Waiting

waiting_since.description: Nivå 3: när ordern till växlarna gick ut.
waiting_since.title: Waiting Since

came_from.description: Nivå 3: sektionen tåget kom från, som ska bli fri innan vägen löses ut efter passage (STV-16).
came_from.title: Came From

part.description: Delställverket vägen tillhör: lagd av delen, eller en godkänd begäran (TKL97).
part.title: Part

request.description: Begäran vägen lades för. Envägsregeln: delen lämnar tillbaka den, och stationen löser inte ut den (RANG-09).
request.title: Request

by.description: Den som fjärrstyr eller en automat; tomt: på platsen.

call.description: Tågbesöket vägen lades för, i hubbens bild. Kommer ankomsten från Hubben löser stationen ut vägen där den inte själv kan se passagen (beslut 22 november).
call.title: Call

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklS.title: TklSetRoute

state.description: Nivå 3: grått, gult, grönt eller Utan adress, som syns i panelen (STV-17).

reported.description: Nivå 3: beskedet som kortet har rapporterat.

end.description: Slutpunkt för en lagd väg: röd i 85 och 95.
end.title: End

blocked.description: Spärrad i stopp: i signalstopp, eller infartssignal till ett lokalt frigivet område (FR41). Fylld röd i 85 och 95.
blocked.title: Blocked

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklS.description: A switch part as the panel shows it.

position.description: Okänt för en växel TKL inte lägger.

protection.description: Låst som skydd, av en väg som inte går över den eller av en lokal frigivning: kort gult vid knuten (STV-20, TKL44).
protection.title: Protection

local.description: Lokalt frigiven: läggs med knappen på modulen, inte av ställverket. Blått streck vid knuten (FR41, TKL44).
local.title: Local

function.description: Panelfunktionen som låser växeln eller friger den.
function.title: Function

state.description: Nivå 3: grått, gult, grönt eller Utan adress, som syns i panelen (STV-17).

reported.description: Nivå 3 med LocoNet: läget växeln har rapporterat. Inget medan den går.

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklS.title: TklSwitchShown

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklT.description:
Ett tåg i ställverket: its number, if any, and where its front is. Without detection
(level 1–2) the number follows the buttons (STV-15). On a section, or on the line outside
an exit, on its way in.

call.description: Tågbesöket i hubbens bild, när det är känt.
call.title: Call

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-answer.TklT.title: TklTrain

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-wait.description: Svaret på väntan: ställverket har ändrats efter after, eller tiden gick ut.
trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-wait.title: TklWait

kinds.description: Vägslagen från starten, tågväg först: ett klick till byter till växlingsväg (STV-24).
kinds.title: Kinds

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-targets.Tkl.description: A goal from a start, for choosing and for showing the way before it is set.

route.description: Vägen, när den redan är lagd.
route.title: Route

trainmeet.tkl-1.interlocking-targets.Tkl.title: TklTarget

trainmeet.tkl-1.route-ask.description:
Lägg en väg: start och mål (STV-01). The goal may be several signals away (TKL53).
Without a kind it is a train route where there is one, else a shunting route (STV-24).
trainmeet.tkl-1.route-ask.title: TklRouteAsk

trainmeet.tkl-1.emergency-release.description: Nödutlösning: releases the route even with a train in it, when confirmed. Logged.
trainmeet.tkl-1.emergency-release.title: TklEmergencyRelease

trainmeet.tkl-1.lever-ask.description:
Klicka på en växel: lägg hela spaken (STV-01, STV-52). Without a position it is laid
over to the other one.
trainmeet.tkl-1.lever-ask.title: TklLeverAsk

trainmeet.tkl-1.lever-ask.Position.description: A switch's two positions. + is straight (rakt), - is diverging (avvikande).
trainmeet.tkl-1.lever-ask.Position.title: Position

trainmeet.tkl-1.train-put.description:
Sätt ut ett tågnummer på ett spår eller på linjen vid en utfart. A train on its way here
is put by its call; TKL finds its exit in Hubben's snapshot (STV-10).
trainmeet.tkl-1.train-put.title: TklTrainPut

trainmeet.tkl-1.reset.description:
Nollställ ställverket: every route released, the switches where they are. With trains,
the train numbers go too. Confirmed and logged.
trainmeet.tkl-1.reset.title: TklReset

trainmeet.tkl-1.function-ask.description:
Manövrera en panelfunktion (STV-04): koppla in eller ur, välj läge, lägg en lokal växel
eller nödutlös. The interlocking says yes, or no with the reason.
trainmeet.tkl-1.function-ask.title: TklFunctionAsk

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-reply.description:
Svar (TKL98): the station approves a request, and its interlocking sets the route, or
refuses it.
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-reply.title: TklPartReply

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-ref.description: A part, for the station: answering its ring.
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-ref.title: TklPartRef

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-request-ask.description:
Begär väg (TKL98): a route out over the border. Refused at once when it cannot go, and
then nothing reaches the station (RANG-10).
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-request-ask.title: TklPartRequestAsk

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-request-ref.description: Lämna tillbaka (TKL98): an approved request returned, or a waiting one taken back.
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-request-ref.title: TklPartRequestRef

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-fika.description: Fika: the part's screen is locked until the part is back, and the station sees it.
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-fika.title: TklPartFika

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-trains.description:
The trains a part chooses among for Klart att skicka. A part that is its own driftplats
has the trains that depart from it in the timetable (TKL108); another part has the
station's trains that stand on a track in its area (TKL110). Another number may be typed.

message.description: Varför listan är tom, när den är det.
message.title: Message

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-trains.title: TklPartTrains

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-trains.TklPartTrain.description: A train the part may announce ready to send: from the plan (TKL108, TKL110).
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-trains.TklPartTrain.title: TklPartTrain

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-message.description:
One of the five messages, as the interlocking hands it on. Locally the station's
interlocking is the whole exchange; when the station is remote-controlled the message goes
through Hubben to whoever remote-controls it, who answers as the station would (TKL100,
DRIFT-40, #36).
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-message.title: TklPartMessage

trainmeet.tkl-1.part-message.TklPartMess.description: The five messages between a part and the station (TKL98).
trainmeet.tkl-1.part-message.TklPartMess.title: TklPartMessageKind

trainmeet.tkl-1.ready-ask.description:
Klart att skicka (TKL108): a train by its number, chosen from the plan or typed. TKL
finds its track and planned departure in the plan when it is there.
trainmeet.tkl-1.ready-ask.title: TklReadyAsk

trainmeet.tkl-1.ready-move.description: Flytta i listan Klara att skicka: the train to its new place, counted from 0.
trainmeet.tkl-1.ready-move.title: TklReadyMove

trainmeet.tkl-1.ready-ref.description: Skickat: the train leaves the list Klara att skicka.
trainmeet.tkl-1.ready-ref.title: TklReadyRef

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.description:
Studio's Koppla in: the connection, the cards, the objects in their four states, and the
learning question as it comes.
trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.title: TklKopplaIn

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.AddressState.description: An object's four states in Koppla in (STUDIO-17, TKL26).
trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.AddressState.title: AddressState

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.ObjectKind.description: What Koppla in connects: a switch part, a signal or a track circuit.
trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.ObjectKind.title: ObjectKind

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.SwitchControl.description: Who lays the switch. Only TKL's switches have a lever, and no route crosses another.
trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.SwitchControl.title: SwitchControl

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklCard.description: An MGP card from Discover, with its module and channels (STUDIO-18, STV-11).

name.description: Till exempel MGP Signal10 SE.
name.title: Name

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklCard.title: TklCard

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklKopplaObjec.description: A switch part, a signal or a track circuit, with its address and its state.

default.description: Adressen är växelns nummer, som förval (STUDIO-19).
default.title: Default

straight.description: Givaren för rakt, med två givare.
straight.title: Straight

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklKopplaObjec.title: TklKopplaObject

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklLearning.description: The object being learnt, and what the owner does now.
trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklLearning.title: TklLearning

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklLevel3.description: Nivå 3: on when the model has addresses and the owner turns it on.
trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklLevel3.title: TklLevel3

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklLoconet.description: The connection to LocoNet. TKL in the cloud never has it (TKLMOLN-08).

available.title: Available

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklLoconet.title: TklLoconet

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklQuestion.description: A learning question as it comes (STUDIO-04): Givaren 73 slog till. Är det Spår 3?

choices.description: Andra objekt av samma slag att välja i stället.
choices.title: Choices

trainmeet.tkl-1.koppla-in.TklQuestion.title: TklQuestion

port.description: Serieporten under /dev, eller låtsas för låtsas-LocoNet.
port.title: Port

trainmeet.tkl-1.loconet-connect.title: TklLoconetConnect

trainmeet.tkl-1.object-change.description:
An object's address as the owner gives it: an address (yellow until it is confirmed on
the layout), none (grey), or Utan adress; and the polarity and the switch's feedback.
trainmeet.tkl-1.object-change.title: TklObjectChange

trainmeet.tkl-1.object-change.ObjectKind.description: What Koppla in connects: a switch part, a signal or a track circuit.
trainmeet.tkl-1.object-change.ObjectKind.title: ObjectKind

trainmeet.tkl-1.learn-ask.description:
Lär in: Lägg om a switch, Skicka kör to a signal, or wait for a wagon on a track
circuit.
trainmeet.tkl-1.learn-ask.title: TklLearnAsk

trainmeet.tkl-1.learn-ask.ObjectKind.description: What Koppla in connects: a switch part, a signal or a track circuit.
trainmeet.tkl-1.learn-ask.ObjectKind.title: ObjectKind

object.description: Ett annat objekt än det föreslagna.
object.title: Object

trainmeet.tkl-1.listen.description: Lyssna, behind Felsök: the last messages, newest first.

trainmeet.tkl-1.pretend-ask.title: TklPretendAsk

trainmeet.tkl-1.prova.description:
Studio's Prova: a simulated train through every route (STUDIO-05, STUDIO-27), run in the
background with its progress, and the results kept with the station until the model
changes. Klart (`tried`) when every route has passed: Ställverket then opens without the
note that the station is not tried.

simulator.description: Hur tåget körs; inget utan stationsmodell.

routes.description: Vägarnas resultat, de som inte gick först.
routes.title: Routes

invalidated.description: Stationsmodellen har ändrats sedan Prova kördes: resultaten gäller inte.
invalidated.title: Invalidated
